Criterion: Verify that clearance is provided in the deployed or stowed position and during the deployment operation to prevent damage to the surface, attached equipment, and to other areas of the air vehicle. Standard: When stationary or in motion, adequate clearance is maintained between the mechanism and all other air vehicle and ground equipment for all expected operational conditions including all air vehicle maintenance. There should be no contact between the mechanism and air vehicle structure or ground systems. Method of Compliance: The design is verified by analysis of components and systems, and accounts for worn states, loading and natural and induced environmental conditions of various components. Component and system tests verify clearances between air vehicle structure and systems. Full scale checkouts on a simulator or on the air vehicle verify system installation, rigging, and clearances. Air vehicle flight and ground tests demonstrate compatibility with air vehicle and ground equipment clearance requirements. References: JSSG-2009: (Appendix I) I.3.4.9.4; I.3.4.9.4.10; I.4.4.9.4.10

Standard: Clearance is provided in the deployed or stowed position and during the deployment operation to prevent damage to the surface, attached equipment, and to other areas of the air vehicle. When stationary or in motion, clearance is maintained between the mechanism and all other air vehicle structure for all expected operational conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of components and systems, including worn states, to verify loading and natural and induced environmental conditions of various components. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct component and system tests to verify clearances between air vehicle structure and systems.
  (2) Lab test: Conduct full scale checkouts on a simulator to verify system installation, rigging, and clearances.
  (3) Ground test: Conduct checkouts of the air vehicle to verify system installation, rigging, and clearances. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (4) Flight test: Conduct air vehicle flight tests to demonstrate compatibility with air vehicle clearance requirements.
